title: WordPress 4.6 PHPMailer Host Header RCE (PwnScriptum)
description: WordPress 4.6, vulnerable to PwnScriptum (CVE-2016-10033 in PHPMailer): the password reset form builds the sender address from the Host header, which goes to the sendmail (Exim) command line, where -be string expansion runs commands.
question: Exploit PwnScriptum through the WordPress password reset form to run commands on the web server and read /ctf/flag.
